non_residential_details.development_type: Change of Use with Extension(s) over 999sqm

description: Redevelopment to provide new light industrial (B1c), general industrial (B2) and warehouse/distribution (B8) building with associated external works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With the appropriate safeguarding conditions the development would not result in harm to the appearance of the site or the wider area, would not cause harm to neighbours' working conditions, and pride a suitable employment premises in accordance with adopted policies IMP.4.1 (Primary Locations for Economic Development), IMP.5.1 (High Quality Building and Urban Design), IMP.6.1 (Planning Obligations), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution), ENV-B.1.6 (Air Pollution), ENV-P.1.1, (Environmental Sustainability: Environmental Impact Statements and Sustainability Checklist), ENV-P.1.3 (Surface Water Run Off), ENV-P.2.1 (Waste Management), ENV-P.2.4 (Recycling Facilities in all New Development), ENV-P.2.6 (Renewable Energy), E.1.1 (Location of New Employment Development), E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use), E.1.3 (Location of General Industry (B2) and Storage and Distribution (B8) Uses), E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria), E.2.3 (Improvement of Employment Sites), E.3.1 (Disabled Access), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), T.6.7 (Public Safety Zones and Other Operational Constraints), of the of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 8 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, [other than small, privately owned, domestic gardens] shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development or any phase of the development, whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.
Condition : 10 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 11 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 5pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 14 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. DWG. No 788-01-A and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 15 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the approved building shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 16 - The building shall be [constructed/adapted] so as to provide insulation against external noise of not less than 40 dB(A), with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided.

Condition : 17 - External lighting to be included in the proposed development should be of flat glass, full cut off design with horizontal mountings so that there is no light spill above the horizontal.
Condition : 18 - The proposed landscaping scheme should not increase the risk of bird strikes to aircraft operating at the aerodrome.
Condition : 19 - No more than approx. 250 people shall be employed at the site at any one time without the written authorisation of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 20 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 21 - No development shall take place until details of measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building and the conservation and re-use as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 22 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may reasonably stipulate.  Any scheme for decontamination of the site shall be in accordance with quality assured methodology and best practice guidance and shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 23 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the approved building shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 24 - Prior to the commencement of the approved development a Green Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The Green Travel Plan shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the building and comply with the provisions of the plan at all times and to use all reasonable endeavours to meet the targets and main aim to achieve a specified minimum percentage of employees using a mode of transport other than the private.  Following the approval of the Green Travel Plan the developer shall monitor and review the workings of the Green Travel Plan at yearly intervals for a minimum period of fifteen years and to submit details of the review to the Council showing how the Plan has operated and specifically how it has been achieving its targets.  With each review it shall be open to the Council to suggest reasonable effective ways of improving the effectiveness of the Green Travel Plan and the developer shall procure the implementation of any such reasonable suggested improvements within a timescale to be agreed by the Council.  Upon any occupier ceasing to occupy the development the next occupant of the development submit to the Council an amendment or variation to the Green Travel Plan which accommodates the occupation by the new occupant.
